facts.text: Penn State World Campus allows students with employer tuition benefits to defer their tuition payments until the semester ends with no interest or finance charges.

sources.title: Employer Reimbursement and Tuition Deferment Program
sources.quote: This program is designed for students whose employers offer reimbursements for tuition charges, upon completion of the semester. Enrolled participants have their tuition payments deferred until the semester is completed, with no finance or interest charges.
